issue: Two Step 2 CK score posts split the 'highest step 2 score' queries in the US

evidence.observation: US Aug-Oct: /blog/how-to-score-280-on-usmle-step-2-ck 5,095 impr CTR 0.35% pos 5.8; /blog/highest-usmle-step-2-ck-score 1,650 impr CTR 0.48% pos 6.0; live US result shows the 'highest' page at #2

seo_impact: Impressions split between two URLs; neither earns the clicks one clear page could.

expected_outcome: One page clearly owns the query; CTR on the owner may improve.

issue: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame or referrer headers

no security headers in frontend/nginx-spa.conf or nginx-cache.conf

recommended_action: Add the headers in nginx (start with HSTS without preload, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors).
expected_outcome: Headers present on every response.

issue: Homepage title claims '#1 USMLE Preparation Platform' without support

title '#1 USMLE Preparation Platform | Next Steps USMLE'; description 'trusted by 700+ students'
